title: 第664章 我这一生如履薄冰你说我能走到对岸吗第663章 特么的老子直接谢伦干
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: “话说回来，主世界的规则变了到底是好还是坏？”苏业微眯着眼睛不由的想道。
脸上带着一丝凝重。
禁忌以后的大战会成为常态，要知道一般的情况下，禁忌基本见都见不到一次。
但是现在半步创世都出来了，鬼知道后面到底有多少神仙打架的事情发生。
“特么的，我真的是太难了。”苏业叹息了一声，有些无力的躺在草地上。
我这一生如履薄冰，你说我能走到对岸吗？
随着时间的流逝。
夜幕降临，领地的篝火升起，苏业没心没肺的和莉莉丝等人拼酒。
事实证明，人是干不过酒精的。
苏业还是躺下了。
第二天苏业浑浑噩噩的来到了混沌泉水这边，几口混沌泉水下去。
苏业才满血复活的活动了一下身体。
查看了今天获得的buff。
祝福之星：真实之眼：你可以看到生灵最真实的一面！！
大道的加护：生生不息的回响：你的兵种可以不断的恢复自身的任何伤势！！
苏业看着今天开出来的两个buff。
“固定：生生不息的回响！”苏业的声音响起。
【叮：你使用权柄固定：生生不息的回响！具体属性可自行查看！】
苏业看了一眼直接关闭了属性面板。
开始了每日的日常任务。
英雄升阶卡
恶魔的契约
十四座兵营+100！
“行吧。”苏业看着邪门召唤殿再次召唤出来的恶魔的契约，也没有在意，无他，习惯了而已。
苏业直接回到了主世界。
“老爷子，我来辣！！！”龙吟声响起。
苏业直接推开了老爷子的办公室大门，走了进去，老爷子正坐在里面，脸上带着一丝不爽的神色。
“怎么了老爷子？”苏业看着一脸不爽的老爷子，有些好奇的问道，谁惹到他了。
“没什么，一些小事情。”老爷子摇了摇头没有说。
苏业也没继续问，老爷子不说的事情，自己不知道为好，苏业突然发现自己好像知道了帝国很多的秘密。
低调，低调，不能再好奇了，好奇心真的会害死猫的。
“没事就回去吧，我还有事情。”老爷子没好气的说道。
“老爷子，我这才刚来啊，你这就嫌弃我了。”苏业带着委屈巴巴的看向老爷子。
老爷子额头青筋暴起：“你以为谁都和你一样，一天天屁事没有，吊儿郎当的到处闲逛？”
“行啊，既然你要留下来陪我好啊，这些东西我交给你处理，不会没关系，我教你。”老爷子看向苏业脸上带着核善的笑容说道。
“额.....那个老爷子，我家里煤气没关，我先走了。”苏业想着老爷子说了一句，转身就开溜。
老爷子看着离开的苏业摇了摇头：“走？走得掉吗？这些事情迟早是你的，现在还年轻那就玩吧。”
苏业这边直接离开了老爷子的办公室，处理公务，苏业是出了名的懒狗。
自己领地的事情都是托管给曦月王，还给学校处理公务，emmm，不可能的，这辈子都不可能的。
content_en:
"Speaking of which, is it a good thing or a bad thing that the rules of the main world have changed?" Su ye squinted his eyes slightly and couldn't help but think.
There was a trace of solemnity on his face.
After Taboo, wars will become the norm. You must know that under normal circumstances, Taboo will rarely see him once.
But now that Half-Step Creation has come out, who knows how many fights between gods and gods will happen in the future.
"Damn it, I'm really in trouble." Su ye sighed and lay on the grass feebly.
My life is like walking on thin ice, do you think I can make it to the other side?
As time goes by.
As night fell, the bonfire in the territory was raised, and Su ye was halfheartedly drinking with Lilith and others.
It turns out that people can’t handle alcohol.
Su ye still lay down.
The next day, Su Ye came to the Chaos Spring in a daze and took a few sips of the Chaos Spring water.
Su Yecai moved his body with full blood.
Check out the buffs you got today.
Blessing Star: Eyes of Truth: You can see the truest side of creatures! !
The protection of the avenue: the endless echo: your troops can continuously recover from any injuries of their own! !
Su ye looked at the two buffs released today.
"Fixed: endless echoes!" Su ye's voice sounded.
[Ding: You use your authority to fix it: the echo will last forever! You can check the specific properties by yourself! 】
Su ye took a look and closed the properties panel directly.
Started daily tasks.
Gold coins +1000w
Hero upgrade card
Devil's Contract
Fourteen barracks +100!
.......
"Okay." Su Ye looked at the demon contract summoned again by the Evil Sect Summoning Hall and didn't care. He was just used to it.
Su ye returned directly to the main world.
"Old man, let me do it!!!" The dragon roar sounded.
Su ye directly opened the door of the old man's office and walked in. The old man was sitting inside with a look of displeasure on his face.
"What's wrong, old man?" Su ye looked at the unhappy old man and asked curiously, who had offended him.
"Nothing, just some small things." The old man shook his head and said nothing.
Su ye didn't continue to ask. It would be better if he didn't know what the old man didn't say. Su ye suddenly found that he seemed to know many secrets of the empire.
Keep a low profile, keep a low profile, and stop being curious. Curiosity will really kill the cat.
"Go back if you have nothing to do. I still have something to do." The old man said angrily.
"Old man, I just came here, and you already dislike me." Su ye looked at the old man with aggrieved look.
The old man's forehead had veins popping out: "Do you think everyone is like you, doing nothing all day long and just wandering around carelessly?"
"Okay, since you want to stay with me, I'll leave these things to you. It doesn't matter, I'll teach you." The old man looked at Su Ye and said with a kind smile on his face.
"Uh...that old man, the gas in my house is not turned off, I'm leaving first." Su ye thought about what the old man said, turned around and ran away.
The old man looked at Su Ye who was leaving and shook his head: "Leave? Can you leave? These things will be yours sooner or later. You are still young, so just have fun."
Su ye left the old man's office directly to handle official business. Su ye was known as a lazy dog.
All the affairs of his own territory are entrusted to King Xiyue, and the school handles official business, emmm, it's impossible, it's impossible in this life.
title_en: Chapter 664: My whole life has been like walking on thin ice. Do you think I can make it to the other side? Chapter 663: Damn it, I’ll just do it to Xie Lun.
